method: Screened all 90 current article titles and rendered bodies for appeal/refusal fit; reviewed matching procedural passages and candidate article context. This is destination-fit review, not complete legal review of every article body. No Saudi civil-procedure service exists in retained catalogue, confirmed with root. Current primary substantive indexed sources used where direct opens failed.
materialFindings: Existing reconsideration article addresses an exceptional remedy and remains root-owned.
Administrative annulment, criminal trial preparation and commercial case outcomes are not interchangeable general appeal destinations.
Article 188 provides a useful memorandum content checklist without fabricating a universal form.
Article 189 review at issuing court precedes ordinary referral; automatic new hearing not promised.
Evidence Article 86 prevents treating same-claim refiling as a general cure after final merits adjudication.
Ordinary cassation targets recognized legal defects, not unrestricted new weighing of evidence.
No universal clock published; small-claims, case-type and actual start-date branches remain explicit gaps.
